scope: Explicit three-mnemonic C compilation unit matches21 native aligned SDK delay clones; bounded counts, zero/underflow, NZCV/register preservation and exact instruction counts
limitations: Positive inputs up to192000 tested; larger counts follow the same byte-identical loop but are not exhaustively executed.
Instruction count and body identity do not measure elapsed hardware time, interrupt preemption, flash/cache wait states or clock frequency.
Whole-image duplicate placement, startup/linking, compiler identity and firmware byte equality remain unresolved.
